t: The EVO3 helmet combines a strong shell for enhanced all-day protection in the widest range of environments, with the comfort benefits of the Evolution 3D-Adjustment harness system. Packed full of the latest protection technology the OneTouch Slip Ratchet, which can be adjusted using one hand in a single swift movement. A 6-point textile cradle harness system offers unrivalled comfort.
b: Compatible With Sonis Ear Defenders & EVOGuard Visors (Sold Separately)
